# ABOUT ME

![](files/profile.jpg){.profile-float}

I am Hye Won Kim, a strategy, operations, and analytics professional based in Boston, Massachusetts.

I have 10+ years of experience across technology, market expansion, business operations, and data-driven decision-making. Most recently, I served as Chief of Staff to the CEO at Blind, where I supported growth strategy, KPI reporting, investor-facing materials, and cross-functional execution for U.S. and India expansion initiatives.

I am currently pursuing an M.S. in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University. Through my coursework, I am building stronger technical skills in analytics, forecasting, cloud computing, data engineering, machine learning, and data visualization.

## Professional Interests

My interests sit at the intersection of business strategy and analytics. I am especially interested in using data to understand growth opportunities, improve business operations, and support better decision-making.

## Career Goals

My goal is to continue building a career in data-driven business strategy, operations, and analytics. I am interested in roles where I can combine my business background with technical skills in Python, SQL, cloud computing, and data visualization.

## Core Strengths

- Business strategy and operations
- Market expansion and go-to-market planning
- KPI reporting and executive communication
- Data analysis and visualization
- Cross-functional project execution
- Technical learning in Python, PySpark, AWS, and Quarto
